integrity: All exact finite-domain generator witnesses and a standalone standard-library checker are bundled; upper certificates are independently replayable, lower obstructions are proved analytically and separately cross-checked. Historical priority may depend on unindexed specialized sources.
scientific_limitations: Only binary dimension-three linear generators, six or seven nonzero requests, and pairwise disjoint recovery sets with at most two columns; no general dimension/request classification, optimizer census or efficient decoder.
title: Exact locality-two functional batch code lengths at six and seven requests
